name_input: KRN HEAT EXCHANGER AND REFRIGERATION LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records (https://importkey.com/countries/india/krn-heat-exchanger-and-refrigeration-limited): "Total Shipments 4196 Records detected ... Latest Cargo 2026-02-27". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-26 | KRN HEAT EXCHANGER AND REFRIGERATION LIMITED | A GROUP S.P.A | A3101230010 EVAPORATOR COILS USED AS HEAT EXCHANGERS FOR AIRCONDITIONING AND REFRIGERATOR PURPOSE 2+1 ROWS COIL GALILEO- | KHATUWAS ICD INCML6, India | Genoa, ITALY | 84195099 | BOL 1041575". Further rows seen: 2026-02-27 → MEKAR AIR HANDLING UNITS LLC, Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 84195099, BOL 1078188; 2026-02-20 → OSHKOSH AEROTECH LLC, Salt Lake City, USA, HS 84195099, BOL 9865952; 2026-02-17 → AMETEK AIRTECHNOLOGY GROUP, London Metropolitan, UK, HS 84195099, BOL 9731289. Source counter vs rows actually seen: page claims 4196 total shipments; 5 individual dated export rows were visible on the free page (plus aggregated buyer/supplier/port counters: MEKAR 1536, TROSTEN 799, A GROUP S.P.A 196, UNILUX VFC 192, A GROUP S.P.A. 137; ports KHATUWAS ICD 221, Jebel Ali 165, Toronto 51, Genoa 48).
domestic_evidence: Listed Indian public company (NSE: KRN, BSE: 544263) with audited GST-invoiced domestic turnover: Screener.in (https://www.screener.in/company/KRN/) standalone P&L shows "Mar 2026 Sales 676" and "Mar 2025 Sales 431" in Rs crore, with quarterly domestic sales of Rs 167–223 crore through Sep 2026 — i.e. real invoiced supply into the Indian market, not a website claim. No GeM/CPPP tender award line was retrievable (search backend returned connection refused), so specific public-procurement contracts are not confirmed.
note: HS code declared in the batch (841950) matches the actual customs HS 84195099 (heat exchangers / evaporator-condenser coils) — no HS correction needed. Industry label 'IT и электроника' in the batch is wrong: the company manufactures fin-and-tube heat exchangers for HVAC&R (Screener: 'manufactures fin and tube-type heat exchangers for the Heat Ventilation Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Industry'). Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records to UAE, Italy, USA and UK, latest 2026-02-27, so this is a genuine manufacturer-exporter, not a trader. Domestic supply confirmed via audited turnover; exact export/domestic revenue split (annual-report geographic segment table) was not retrieved — null, not estimated. Volza/Eximpedia free views returned HTTP 403, so ImportKey was the sole shipment source; the 4196 figure is the portal's own counter and was not independently cross-checked row-by-row.
